facts.text: InterContinental Malta is located in St. George's Bay in St. Julian's.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of St. George’s Bay in St. Julian’s, InterContinental Malta

facts.text: The hotel is by the beach in St. George's Bay, a short walk from the sea.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the ultimate coastal experience, where the sea is just a short, luxurious walk from your room.

facts.text: The hotel has three pools: two outdoor and one indoor.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in refined relaxation with our 3 pools, 2 outdoor, 1 indoor.

facts.text: The SkyBeach infinity pool is on the 19th floor with panoramic island and Mediterranean Sea views.
facts.excerpt: Ascend to the 19th floor and relax at the stunning infinity pool. Let the world pass by with panoramic island and Mediterranean Sea views.

facts.text: Suite bookers get complimentary access to the SkyBeach rooftop pool; other guests can access it for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Suite bookers enjoy complimentary access to this rooftop luxury. Other guests can gain access for an additional fee

facts.text: The outdoor pools include a lagoon-style pool, and an indoor pool offers year-round swimming.
facts.excerpt: bask in the sun at the lagoon-style Poolside Paradise. For year-round tranquility, retreat to our serene Indoor Oasis.

facts.text: All guests get complimentary access to the InterContinental Beach Club, with sunbeds, umbrellas and towels provided.
facts.excerpt: All guests enjoy complimentary access to the InterContinental Beach Club. We provide sunbeds, umbrellas, and towels so you can simply lie back and relax.

facts.text: The Beach Club has a bar and restaurant.
facts.excerpt: The Beach Club features a bar and restaurant with quick, efficient service.

facts.text: The hotel has an on-site spa offering bespoke treatments.
facts.excerpt: Experience ultimate relaxation at our luxury spa on site. Indulge in bespoke treatments

facts.text: The spa has a sauna.
facts.excerpt: - Sauna

facts.text: The hotel's Cynergi Health & Fitness Centre is described as Malta's biggest fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: After your workout in Malta’s biggest fitness centre, complement your fitness journey with spa treatments

facts.text: Rooms have plush beds, spa-like bathrooms and a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: each room offers a luxurious retreat with plush beds, spa‑like bathrooms, and a private balcony.

facts.text: Some suites may include a separate jetted bath with walk-in rain shower.
facts.excerpt: - Separate Jetted Bath with Walk-in Rain Shower

facts.text: The Club InterContinental Lounge offers private check-in and panoramic views across Malta and the Mediterranean.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy private check-in, refined service, and panoramic views across Malta and the Mediterranean.

facts.text: The Club InterContinental Lounge serves breakfast, afternoon tea and evening canapes.
facts.excerpt: From a sumptuous breakfast to afternoon tea and evening canapés

facts.text: Paranga is a seaside restaurant on teak decking beside the Mediterranean, serving Sicilian flavours.
facts.excerpt: Our exquisite seaside restaurant is set on teak decking right beside the rippling Mediterranean Sea. The menu offers a superb array of Sicilian flavours

facts.text: Local fishermen deliver fresh fish and shellfish to Paranga daily.
facts.excerpt: Local fishermen deliver fresh fish and shellfish daily

facts.text: Waterbiscuit is a French bistro inspired restaurant using Mediterranean ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Waterbiscuit is French bistro inspired restaurant offering a charming, contemporary gastronomic experience with enthusiastically accomplished cuisine, featuring the freshest Mediterranean ingredients.

facts.text: Valletta, a UNESCO World Heritage city, is about 7 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: you are just 7km away from this UNESCO World Heritage city.

facts.text: The concierge can arrange guided tours and cruises to Gozo and Comino.
facts.excerpt: Organised guided tours and cruises are available at the concierge.

facts.text: The hotel has 24 meeting spaces.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Malta offers 24 versatile meeting spaces including advanced AV technology.

facts.text: The hotel holds Green Key sustainability certification.
facts.excerpt: **Certifications: Green Key (FEE)**

facts.text: Self-parking is available for a daily fee.
facts.excerpt: At InterContinental Malta, self-parking is available for a daily rate of 17 EUR .

facts.text: The hotel does not include complimentary breakfast.
facts.excerpt: No, InterContinental Malta does not offer complimentary breakfast.

facts.text: St. Julian's location gives access to dining, entertainment and beaches.
facts.excerpt: This prime position ensures immediate access to the finest dining, entertainment, and beaches on the island

facts.text: InterContinental Malta has established itself as one of the Mediterranean's leading luxury hotels.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Malta has established itself as one of the Mediterranean’s leading luxury hotels.

facts.text: Pet policy: one page says pets are not allowed, another allows dogs.
facts.excerpt: Pets allowed: Only dogs allowed

contradictions.note: p1 FAQ says no pets; p4 says dogs allowed

sources.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at InterContinental Malta.

contradictions.note: p1 says 14-minute (10 km) drive and also 12 km; p8 says 20-minute drive

sources.excerpt: only a 14-minute (10 km) drive from Malta International Airport
Malta International Airport (MLA) is just a 20-minute drive.
